<h3>Gamecraft! 2024</h3>

Gamecraft! was my CCA's annual year-end game jam, where tertiary students across Singapore teamed up to develop a fully functional game in a week. We decided on a cute space-alien theme, with motifs of gears (since the Gamecraft! logo featured a gear and wrench).

This is what I came up with!
